verses.verse_content: Anuanom Akristofo ee
Mosɔ mogyedi mu den
Awurade da no deɛ
Ɛbɛ yɛ dwee

Ɔreba oo 
Yesu reba oo 
Ao menua 
Ɛnti sakyera wadwene 
Awurade reba oo sakyera wadwene
Asafo no fapem koro Ne yɛn Wura Yesu Ɔnam nsuo ne N’ asɛm so Yɛɛ N’abɔdeɔ foforɔ Ofi soro bɛhwehwɛɛ no Yɛɛ N’ ayeforɔ kronkron Ɔde ne mogya tɔɔ no Ne nkwa nti na owui.
Wɔpaa no fi amanaman mu Nanso ɔyɛ asafo koro Ne nkwagyeɛ tumi no ni Wura koro, Gyidie koro Ohyira din kronkron biako Di n’ aduan kronkron no Anidasoɔ koro na ɔpɔro Adom nyinaa wɔ mu.
Sɛ nnipa si m’ atweetwe Hwɛ n’ ahokyerɛ kɛseɛ Mpaapaamu a atete mu Ne Nkyerɛkyerɛ bɔne a Ahotefoɔ no wɛn su Sɛ: Ɛnkosi da bɛn? Anadwo su ne renkyɛ Na adan anɔpa dwom.
Awurade ne me dwanhwɛfoɔ Merenhia biribi Ɔma me da wira frɔmm mu Ɔgya me nsutae ho ( D.C.).
Ɔde me kra san ba nkwam bio Na ɔma me nante Ne nneyɛe trenee kwan no so N’ ankasa Ne din nti (D.C.).
Menam owuo sum bɔn mu mpo a Mensuro mmusuo biara Wone me nante, Wo poma Ne W’ abaa hyɛ me den (D.C).
Me pono nso woawie to deda Wɔ m’ atamfo anim Wode ngo fɔ me tiri mu Me kuruwa bu so (D.C).
Yie ne adɔe bedi m’ akyi Me nkwa nna nyinaa mu Na mede Nyame fie bɛyɛ Me tenabea daa nyinaa (D.C).
Hwan na ‘bɛdi Yesu akyi Agyina ama tenenee Ama ne frankaa no so Wɔ ‘ko kɛse mu Atie ne mara no pɛsɛ ɔbɛdi so Hwan na bɛdi Yesu akyi asom no ɛnnɛ?
Hwan na ɔbɛdi Yesu akyi abrabɔ yi mu ‘Yɛ adwuma ma owura no ayi no ayɛ Abɔ mɔden n’afuom adi ne mara so Atie n’afotuo ahwɛ ne ho ‘yie.
Hwan n’ɔbɛdi Yesu akyi sɛ nsɔhwɛ ba a Adwan’ akɔ asomdwoe Agyenkwa no nsam Atwere n’ahumɔbɔ atwere ne tumi Ahwehwɛ ayɛ foforo n’adom mu merɛ nyinaa?
Hwan na n’ɔbɛdi Yesu akyi ne ‘dɔ adwuma yi mu Twetwe nkorɔfoɔ ma no wɔ mpaebɔ mu Asomfoɔ nokwafoɔ yɛ hu na sɛm mu Saa Agynkwa yi bɛ wɔ yɛafa daadaa.

Yɛbɛto nwom wɔ kana bio Nyame yɛ dɔ Yɛbɛbom ato dwom kɛse Nyame yɛ dɔ Bere a mfesanten rekɔ no Yɛne s’ ro dɔm bɛdi nkonim Na yɛn dwom a ɛyɛ dɛ bɛka sɛ Nyame yɛ dɔ.

verses.verse_content: Me pɛ sɛ me yɛ adwuma ma Awurade Me pɛ sɛ metwere n’asɛm kronrkon no Na mato nnwom abɔ mpae’ Ayɛ adwuma dabiara ‘Wɔ Awurade ahenie mu.
Me pɛ sɛ me yɛ adwuma dabiara Na mekyerɛ wɔn a wɔafom ɔkwan no A ɛkɔ hɔ faako asomdwoe ne ‘dɔ wɔ Awurade ahenie mu.
Me pɛ sɛ menyaa hoɔden ne aboɔduru Na metwere Yesu nkwagye tumi no Wɔn a wɔba nokorɛ mu Benya anigye tenabea Wɔ Awurade ahenie mu.
Awurade boa me na me nyɛ adwuma Mentwe deɛ wɔayera mmra woasɛm no mu. Ɛkyerɛ anigye wɔ ‘soro Faako ahosɛpɛ ntwa Awurade ahenie mu.

verses.verse_content: Mede me bɔne a Mentumi nkwan brɛ Wo Na Woahoro me ho Wo mmogya abura no mu M’ Agyenkwa me de mebrɛ Wo Ne duru hyɛ me so dodo.

Mede me koma a Mennim m nsɛm brɛ Wo Daadaafoɔ kobɔfoɔ Koma bɔne ampa M’ Agyenkwa mede hyɛ Wo nsa Ma ɛntim, ɛnyɛ nokwafoɔ
Mede me nkwa brɛ Wo Mew nna so ne me ho M’Agyenkwa ma me nyɛ Wonko Wo dea daa Mekoma, nkwa, m’ ade nyinaa Mede brɛ Wo, me hene, Gyefoɔ.
Agyenkwa wo dɔ nti Wowu maa me Ɛmmfata sɛ mede Biribi kam’ wo Dɔm’ me kra koto wo Adi ne bɔhyɛ so Na wabɔ afɔdeɛ Ama w’seesei.
Ma me nokorɛ koma A ɛsɛ wo de no Na dabiara mu no Woahu me sɛ Mahyɛ dɔ dwuma bi ase Mayɛ ayamyɛ bi Matwe kobɔfoɔ bi Mede ama wo.
Deɛ mewɔ, deɛ meteɛ W’akyɛdeɛ kwa Dɛ mu o yea mu o ‘Wura meyɛ wo de Na mehu woanim a Me kra a woagye nyinaa no yi Merɛsanten nyinaa mu Bɛyɛ wode.
Kristofoɔ asraafoɔ Monnuom akono Yesu asennua no De yɛn anim kan Yɛn Hene atu sa Reko tia tamfoɔ Monnuom sraban no so Monhwɛ Ne frankaa.
Yɛma Ne frankaa so a Ɔbonsam dɔm gu Ɛnneɛ Kristo akofoɔ Monkɔdi nkonim Yɛbɔ se yi ayɛ a Saman fapem him Anuanom monto nnwom Momma mo nne so.
Ahennwa bɛtutu Ahennie atwam Yesu asɔre de Ɛbɛtim hɔ daa Asaman apon no Rentumi nhyɛ so Yɛwɔ Kristo bɔhyɛ N’ asɛm rentwam da.
Me nkurɔfoɔ momɛdɔm Anigyeɛ kuo yi Mommra na yɛmmom nto Yɛn nkunim dwom yi Anuonyam ne nkamfoɔ Nka yɛ Hene no Nnipa ne abɔfoɔ Bɛto dwom yi daa.

content.chorus: Kristofoɔ asraaafoɔ Monnuom akono Yesu asennua no Di yɛn anim kan.

Ɛrenkyɛ pii na yɛagyae ase ha akyinkyin Ɛrenkye pii bia n’ ahotefo akɔ fie Yɛde anigye bɛnante sika mmrɔno so Yɛbɛtena ase daadaa ayi yɛn gyefo ayɛ.
Ɛrenkyɛ pii bia yɛbɛsoɛ yɛn nnesoa Ɛrenkyɛ pii bia na yɛanya ahenkyɛ Na yɛnne abɔfo bɛto dwom atwa ahennwa n’ ho Na yɛhyia soro hɔ’ a yɛbɛhu ade nyinaa.
Ɛrenkyɛ pii bia na asase atwan akɔ Ɛrenkyɛ pii bia nnipa nwuma bɛseɛ Na Yesu asiesie anigye tenabea bi Ma wɔn a wɔhwɛ soro twɛne n’ adom kɛse n’

Ͻbɛbɔ wɔ N’Agya anim hɔ Me din a ɛnsɛ yi Na Jerusalem foforɔ mu Wama me kra tenabea

verses.verse_content: Fa Twerɛ no ma me Ɛyɛ anigye nsoroma Ɛkyekye kwantumi brɛfoɔ werɛ Ahum bi ntumi nnha saa nsoroma yi nkyɛ ‘Fi sɛ Yesu baa bɛgyee deɛ wayera
Fa Twerɛ no ma me Berɛ a mekoma ayɛ merɛ Na bɔne hu ahyɛ me kra ma Fa nsɛmpa a Yesu aka no ma me Ma gyedie kanea so sɛ Yesu abɛn.
Fa Twerɛ no ma me Na ɛnhyerɛn me kwan so Ɛnkyerɛn me wiase ha musuo Ahotɔ kanea no bɛpam musuo nyinaa Kanea no nko na ɛkyerɛ ‘somdwoe kwan
Fa Twerɛ no ma me Daa nkwa hann a ɛnnum da Ɛhyerɛn fɛfɛ wɔ deɛ damoa abue Kyerɛ me hann a ɛfi soro apondwa mu Kyerɛ me anuonyam a efi Jordan mu.

verses.verse_content: Ɛka bɛn na me deɛ me wura M’ade pa bi a mɛtumi anya? Memfa m’ade bi nkame wo Wo a woagye w’ade nyinaa wu maam’
Menni sika anaa dwetɛ Nanso mennfa biribi nkwan’ wo Menkwa, medɔ ne me som nso Mɛdi nokorɛ ama wo nko.
Wotuaa me ka asɛnnua so Wɔde mafodie to wo so Wo nko na wobɛtumi ahu’ Ɛka kɛse a me de me wura.

Ka me ho ‘wura Mentumi nkwati wo ntena ase Mentumi nnya wo ntu ‘namɔn biako Wo ammoa me a Menntumi nsoa ‘bra adesoa yi Mehia sɛ me twere wo ahoɔden.
Ka me ho ‘wura Na sɛ amaneɛ bɛn a Na sɔhwɛ ahum tu fa me tiri so a Anaa nsuo yiri twa me ho hyia mpo a Hwee rennyɛ me, na mekoma mmɔ hu.
Ka me ho ‘wura Akyɛdeɛ anaa nhyira bi Ɛnntumi nkyɛn deɛ wode ama me yi Na menim sɛ wo ka me ho daa nyinaa Metenka baabi’ a me wɔ sɛ wobɛn.
Ka me ho ‘wura Sɛ menni obi mpo a Sɛ ɛba sɛ me su wɔ yea mu a Na me merɛ a mɛfi asaase yi so du a O mesrɛ sɛ Awurade, ka me ho.
Menam awia mu, m’akwantu yi mu Wɔ mmepɔ so ne abun mu Yesu aka sɛ, merennya wo daa Bɔhyɛ kronkron a, ɛtim hɔ daa.
Ɛsum a atwa me ho ahyia yi Ɛntumi nka m’agyenkwa no nhyɛ Ɔno na ɔyɛ hann, ɛsum nni ne mu Mekɔso nante ne nkyɛn daa.
Owia hann no mu medi ahurusie Merepem so kɔ soro aban mu Meyi nayɛ, me nante anigyem Menam ‘wia hann mu, ɔdɔ hann no.

content.chorus: ‘Soro awia hann, ‘soro awia hann De anuonyam kronkron ba me kra so. Hal-le-lujah, meredi ahurusie Mereyi n’ayɛ, Yesu yɛ mede.

verses.verse_content: Yiw me na ɔde ɔdɔ Ne ahwɛyie dwen me ho Yiw ɔne me kyɛ Me nnesoa ne me hu nyinaa Yiw me so, me so na ɔhwɛ Ɔwɛn me awia ne anadwo Yiw me mpo, me mpo Ɔhwim me fi ɔkwan mu mmusuo mu.
Yiw ɔgyina ahummɔbɔ adwa anim Resrɛ ma me Na ɔkɔ so di ma me ɔdɔ a ɛnsa da mu Yiw ɔma me nya wɔ me mu Soro anigye, ɔdɔ, ɛne hann Na ɔde ne dɔ taban tumi no Kata me so.
Yiw ɔte, ɔte me mu Na me nso me te ne mu Ɔde anidaso hyɛ me kra ma Maba mu bu a Ɛnti merewen ne mmae Mereto dwom akɔ soro Anɔpa ahosɛpɛ nnwom Ne anwumere nnwom.
Yɛn Nyame yɛ abankɛse Kyɛm a enni huammɔ da Ɔno na ɔyɛ yɛn boafoɔ Ɔbra nsuyiri yi mu Yɛn tamfo dada no Hwehwɛ yɛn sɛeɛ ara Ne nnaadaa tumi so Ɔtan ahyɛ no ma Ne so bi ni asaase yi so.
Yɛn ankasa ahoɔden mu no Yɛn mmɔdenmɔ bɛyɛ kwa Barima pa bi wɔ yɛafa Deɛ Onyame apa no no Wobisa oniiko? Kristo Yesu ne No. Asafo Awurade Ɔnsakyera mfesanten mu Na ɛtwa sɛ odi nim.

Sɛ bɔne ahyɛ wiase ma Repɛ sɛ ɛsee yɛn a Yɛrensuro Nyame ama N’asɛm nam yɛn so di nim Yɛhwere ahode, abusua Na saa nkwa tia’ yi nso Wɔbɛkum nnipadua yi Nyame asɛm te hɔ daa Nahenie no wɔ hɔ daa nyinaa.
Wo ne me ntena ade reyɛ asa Sum reduru, awurade tena menkyɛn Aboafoɔ pa, ne awerɛkyekyefoɔ sa a O Ankonam Boafoɔ, Wo ne me ntena.
Yɛn nkwa nna ketewa yi retwam kɔ Wiase dɛ repa, n’ anuonyam resen Ɔsɛe ne nsakyera nko na me hu ha Ao, Wo a Wonsakyera da, Wo ne me ntena.
Mehia Wo wɔ me nkyɛn berɛ nyinaa W’ adom na ɛka sɔhwɛfoɔ no hyɛ Gyefoɔ, kyuingyinafoɔ bɛn ɛne wo sɛ? Sum mu o, hann mu o, Wo ne me ntena.
Sɛ me ne Wo nam a mensuro hwee Ɔyea nyɛ duru, nnisuo nyɛ nnwono Wuo bɔre, damoa nkonim ɛwɔ he? Medi nkonim daa sɛ Wo ne me tena a.
Memua mani a yi W’ asennua kyerɛ me. Hyerɛn sum mu, kyerɛ me soro kwan Ɔsoro hyerɛn, wiase kusuu resa Owuo mu o, nkwa mu o, Wo ne me ntena.
Mennim sɛ nti a Nyame ayi n ‘adom Nwanwa akyerɛ me Anaa sɛ nti a me a menfata yi ɔde Ne dɔ agye me.
Mennim sɛ deɛ ɔgyeɛ gyidie Yi hyɛɛ me mu Ne sɛdeɛ n’ asɛm no ho gyidie de. Asomdwee ba makomam.
Mennim papa anaa bɔne a ɔde Ato hɔ retwɛn me Anaa ɔbrɛ akwan anaa nnepa Ansa na m’ ahu n’ anim
Sɛ me wura no bɛba anadwo anaa Sɛ awia ketee a me deɛ mennim Anaa sɛ me ne no bɛnante bun mu Anaa sɛ mɛhyia no ewie mu.

content.chorus: Nanso me nim deɛ m’agye n’madi Na megyedi sɛ ɔbɛtumi de Deɛ mede ahyɛ ne nsa no Asie akɔdu da no.

verses.verse_content: Yɛrenante Agyenkwa anamɔn mu. Yɛredi yɛn Agyenkwa ne hene akyi Yɛde ne nsɛnnahɔ no bu yɛn bra ‘Nigye, anigye nwom na yɛde ba.
Yɛtwe pini deɛ ɔdii yɛanim no ho Sɛ sɔhwɛ ma yɛfi kwan no mu a, Yɛdan basa denden ɛbɔ yɛn ho ban ‘Nigye mu na yɛyi n’ayɛ daa.
Yɛrenante Agyenkwa anamɔn mu Yɛdi yɛ kwankyerɛfoɔ n’akyi kɔ soro Sɛ yɛhu yɛn hene wɔ n’ahoɔfɛm ‘Nigye mu na yɛbɛtena ne nkyɛn.

May speak their joys abroad.

The hill of Zion yields
A thousand sacred sweets,
Before we reach the heavenly fields,
Before we reach the heav’nly fields
Or walk the golden streets,
Or walk the golden streets.

Then let our songs abound,
And ev’ry tear be dry;
We’re marching thru Immanuel’s ground,
We’re marching thru Immanuel’s ground,
To fairer worlds on high, to fairer worlds on high.

Love divine, all love excelling,
Joy of heav’n, to earth come down
Fix in us Thy humble dwelling
All Thy faithful mercies crown
Jesus, Thou art all compassion,
Pure, unbounded love Thou art;
Visit us with Thy salvation,
Enter ev’ry trembling heart.

Come, almighty to deliver,
May we all Thy life receive;
Suddenly return, and never,
Never more Thy temples leave;
Thee we would be always blessing,
Serve Thee as Thy hosts above
Pray, and praise Thee, without ceasing,
Glory in Thy perfect love.

Finish then Thy new creation,
Pure, unspotted, may we be;
May we see our whole salvation
Perfectly secured by Thee;
Changed form glory into glory,
Till in heav’n we take our place,
Till we cast our crowns before Thee,
Lost in wonder, love and praise

When the Savior calls I will anser,
When He calls for me I will hear;
When the Savior calls I will answer,
I’ll be somewhere list’ning for my name

If my heart is right when He calls me,
If my heart is right I will hear;
If my heart is right when He calls me,
I’ll be somewhere list’ning for my name.

If my robe is white when He calls me,
If my robe is white I will hear;
If my robe is white when He calls me,
I’ll be somewhere list’ning for my name.

content.chorus:
I’ll be somewhere list’ning ,I’ll be somewhere list’ning
I’ll be somewhere list’ning for my name
Yes, for my name;
I’ll be somewhere list’ning, I’ll be somewhere list’ning
I’ll be somewhere list’nin for my name.

verses.verse_content:
Tempted and tried we’re oft made to wonder
Why it should be thus all the day long,
While there are others living about us,
Never molested tho in the wrong,

When death has come and taken our loved ones,
It leaves our home so lonely and drear;
Then do we wonder why others prosper,
Living so wicked year after year.

Faithful till death said our loving Master,
A few more days to labor and wait;
Toils of the road will then seem as nothing,
As we sweep through the beautiful gate.

When we see Jesus coming in glory,
When He comes from His home in the sky;
Then we shall meet Him in that bright mansion,
We’ll understand it all by and by.

content.chorus:
Farther along we’ll know all about it ,
Farther along we’ll understand why;
Cheer up, my brother,live in the sunshine,
We’ll understand it all by and by.

verses.verse_content:
Far whiter than snow, and as fair as the day,
For Christ is the fountain to wash guilt away;
O give Him, poor sinner, that burden of thine,
And enter the fold with the ninety-and-nine.

Yon sheep, that was lost in the valley of sin,
Was found by the Shepherd, who gathered him in;
With songs of thanksgiving the hills did resound,
"My friends and my neighbors, the lost sheep is found."

Ride over temptation and cease your alarms:
Your Shepherd is Jesus, your refuge His arms;
He'll never forsake you, a Brother and Friend,
But love you and save you in worlds without end.

content.chorus:
Whiter (than) the snow, (I long to be, dear Savior,)
Whiter (than) the snow, (I long to be,)
Whiter (than) the snow, (I long to be, dear Savior,)
Whiter than snow. (Whiter than the snow, Whiter than the snow.)

hymns.title: TIS SO SWEET TO TRUST IN THE JESUS

verses.verse_content:
O, how sweet to trust in Jesus,
Just to trust His cleansing blood,
Just in simple faith to plunge me
Neath the healing cleansing flood.

Yes, tis sweet to trust in Jesus,
Just from sin and self to cease;
Just from Jesus simply taking Life,
And rest, and joy, and peace.

I’m so glad I learned to trust Thee,
Precious Jesus, Savior, Friend
And I know that Thou art with me,
Wilt be with me to the end.

I’ll reach the land of corn and wine,
And all its riches freely mine;
There shines undimmed one blissful day,
For all my night will pass away.

The Saviour comes and walks with me,
And sweet communion here have we;
He gently leads me by the hand,
For this is heaven’s border land,

A sweet perfume upon the breeze,
Is borne from ever vernal tree,
And flow’rs that never fading grow,
Where streams of life forever flow.

The zephyrs seem to float to me ,
Sweet sounds of heaven’s melody,
As angels with the white robed throng,
Join in the sweet redemption song.

Worthy of praise is Christ our Redeemer,
Worthy of glory, honor and pow’r
Worthy of all our souls and adoration,
Worthy art Thou.

Lift up the voice in praise and devotion,
Saints of all earth before Him should bow;
Angels in heaven worship Him saying,
Worthy art Thou

Lord, may we come before Thee with singing,
Filled with Thy spirit, wisdom and pow’r;
May we ascribe Thee glory and honor,
Worthy art Thou.

content.chorus:
Worthy art Thou, worthy of riches, blessings and honor
Worthy of wisdom, glory and pow’r
Worthy of earth and heaven’s thanksgiving
Worthy art Thou

verses.verse_content:
There is much to do, there’s work on every hand,
Hark! The cry for help comes ringing thru the land
Jesus calls for reapers, I must active be,
What wilt Thou, O master?
Here am I, ,send me

There’s the plaintive cry of mourning souls distressed,
And the sigh of hearts who seek but find no rest;
These should have my love and tender sympathy,
Ready at Thy bidding, here am, I send me.

There are hung’ ring souls, who cry aloud for bread,
With the bread of life they’re longing to be fed;
Shall they starve and famish while a feast is free?
I must be more faithful, here am I, send me.

content.chorus:
Her am I, Lord, send me,
Here am I Lord, send me,
Ready at Thy bidding, Lord send me.

verses.verse_content:
There’s a land that is fairer than day,
And by faith we can see it afar
For the Savior waits over the way,
To prepare us a dwelling place there

We shall sing on that beautiful shore
The melodious songs of the blest
And our spirits shall sorrow no more,
Not a sigh for the blessings of rest.

To our bountiful Father above,
We will offer our tribute of praise
For the glorious gift of His love,
And the blessings that hallow our days.

content.chorus:
In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on that beautiful shore,
In the sweet by and by,
We shall meet on the beautiful shore.
